布朗先生

zh: a comedy character played in a British television series by the actor Rowan Atkinson. The programmes have very few spoken words and show Mr Bean in funny or embarrassing situations
en: a comedy character played in a British television series by the actor Rowan Atkinson. The programmes have very few spoken words and show Mr Bean in funny or embarrassing situations
ex: Well, say something! Don't just stand there like Mr Bean.
好吧，说点什么！不要像豆先生那样站在那儿。

zh: the name of a figure drawn by people on walls and other public places in Britain. He is usually shown as a face appearing above a wall, with a message complaining about a lack of something, such as ‘Wot (= What) no sausages?’ These drawings began to appear during the Second World War when Britain lacked many types of food and other things. They are less commonly seen now.

zh: an expression sometimes used to refer to a male teacher, especially one who is loved by his students. It comes from the main character in the novel Goodbye Mr Chips by James Hilton.
